title: Observe a character tuple on the ability screen
changes: Document the scoped effect of the first complete source-listed character tuple after an authenticated ability-screen redraw while retaining the reference-only quarantine.
validation: A protected paired USA DS-16 Wine/Xvfb experiment applied the first complete guide tuple once to the treated copy and no write to the control. Both followed the verified B/Up/A route for the same 144 frames with no maintained cheats. The control ability screen displayed Soldier; the treated screen displayed Gunner and different ability labels. The specified target bytes remained changed only in the treated copy. Both windows closed normally and Wine drained; protected ROM, checkpoint, earlier evidence and executable were unchanged. Evidence: target/validation/units/dbg20-character-ability-screen-h75fjx8y/.
Visual evidence was inspected separately; a prior one-frame route had remained on the job screen and was not evidence of an ability-screen redraw.
limitations: This supports the complete tuple in one checkpoint and screen, not independent meanings of its fields, other combinations, physical devices or native Windows. CH-0236 remains excluded; current character examples remain reference-only.
